entries.name: X0X
entries.use: Felucca fork (909, 808, two 303s, a break slicer); its unmodified firmware code runs in the studio twin, with the engines it ports (the 909 and 808 after 9W9 and 8W8 by athousanddetails, the 303 after Open303 by Robin Schmidt, MIT)

entries.name: FoMni
entries.use: chord harp on X0X's platform; its unmodified firmware code runs in the studio twin, with Chordian's rhythms and sounds by Jan125 (CC0)

entries.name: AMB-1
entries.use: generative ambient machine on fm1-base; its unmodified firmware code runs in the studio twin

entries.name: LOOM-8
entries.use: groovebox on fm1-base; its unmodified firmware code runs in the studio twin, with the parts it ports (its LICENSING.md)

entries.name: fm1-base / felucca-bsp
entries.authors: Charles Vestal; Leo Kuroshita / Hügelton Instruments
entries.use: platform, host simulator and browser emulator of AMB-1 and LOOM-8, compiled into their studio twins
